mapper.select: SELECT id, goal_id, project_id, title, description, priority, status, due_date, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (due_date = #{date} OR due_date IS NULL OR (due_date < #{date} AND status <> 'DONE')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN due_date < #{date} AND status <> 'DONE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, id DESC

INSERT INTO task(user_id, goal_id, project_id, title, description, priority, status, due_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{task.goalId}, #{task.projectId}, #{task.title}, #{task.description}, #{task.priority}, COALESCE(#{task.status}, 'TODO'), #{task.dueDate}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
